content.text:
name: scenarios
services:
  data_store_backend:
    build:
      context: /workspace/apps/data_store_backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        INDEX_URL: ""
    command:
      - sh
      - scripts/start-server.sh
    container_name: data-store-backend-service
    environment:
      API__ENVIRONMENT: COMPOSE_ALL
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 8000
        published: "8007"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /workspace/apps/data_store_backend
        target: /app
        bind: {}
      - type: bind
        source: /workspace/apps/data_store_backend/data_store
        target: /data_store
        bind: {}
networks:
  default:
    name: scenarios_default

observation.command: cd /workspace/deployment/runtimes/compose/dev && docker compose -f scenarios/debug-data_store_backend.yml config 2>&1 | head -40
